description: This file contains utility functions for taking and combining tiled screenshots of web page elements using Playwright and PIL. It includes functions to scroll through large elements, capture multiple image tiles, and stitch them into a single image.

methods.name: combine_screenshot_tiles
methods.description: Combines multiple PNG screenshot tiles into a single vertical image.

methods.name: take_tiled_screenshot
methods.description: Captures a large element by scrolling and taking multiple screenshots, then stitches them into one image.
